strings: Zankaja is a young orc woman living in Orgrimmar, residing along the path between the Valley of Strength and the Valley of Wisdom. She anxiously awaits news of her mate, Dogran, who was assigned to duty at the Crossroads in the dangerous frontier of the Barrens.

Life in the fledgling Horde capital is demanding, but for Zankaja, the true ordeal is the waiting. Her mate Dogran earned a promotion that sent him south into the Barrens to bolster the outpost at the Crossroads. While an honor for a warrior, the Barrens is a brutal expanse crawling with quilboar, centaur, and aggressive beasts. When Dogran failed to send word or return home as expected, Zankaja began seeking out travelers willing to seek news of his fate.

Zankaja's worst fears prove warranted when inquiries in the Barrens uncover that Dogran fell into the clutches of the quilboar. Though she holds onto hope within Orgrimmar's canyon walls, the frontier is unforgiving, and the news brought back by adventurers paints a grim picture of sacrifice on the Horde's perilous borders.
Zankaja stands along the path connecting the Valley of Strength and the Valley of Wisdom in the city of Orgrimmar.

Zardeth of the Black Claw is a warlock dwelling in the dim subterranean chambers beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. Operating under the guise of an unassuming patron, he coordinates covert measures to protect the city's hidden warlock cabal from outside scrutiny. When inquisitive nobles begin looking too closely into their activities, Zardeth ensures those inquiries end permanently.

While the Mage Quarter's towering spires study arcane discipline in the open, the underground tunnels beneath the Slaughtered Lamb house those who traffic in darker arts. Zardeth of the Black Claw operates from these crypts, functioning as a watchful guardian for the practitioners hiding right beneath the city guard's nose. Because the Alliance officially condemns fel magic, survival requires an ironclad secret and a willingness to eliminate any threat before royal investigators come knocking.

When Lord Baurles K. Wishock discovered whispers of the hidden warlock coven, the nobleman began lobbying the House of Nobles for an immediate, full-scale investigation. Aware that such scrutiny would destroy their underground haven, Zardeth arranged a clandestine countermeasure. Capitalizing on the lord's known indulgence in fine liquor, Zardeth dispatched an operative across the eastern kingdoms to gather rare, lethal flora—the Tear of Tilloa from Duskwood and Musquash Root from beneath the Stonewrought Dam.

Blending the gathered reagents with stout ale, Zardeth concocted the Black Claw Stout, a lethal vintage engineered to look like an ordinary luxury gift. Once delivered to Wishock's estate, the poisoned brew did its work swiftly and quietly. With Wishock dead and his campaign extinguished before the crown could intervene, Zardeth and his fellow warlocks successfully safeguarded the subterranean enclave beneath the Slaughtered Lamb.

Zargh is an orc meat merchant stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens. Aside from providing provisions to travelers, he frequently supplies choice cuts of local game to Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

Amid the bustle of the Crossroads, Zargh tends his shop selling various cuts of cured meat, shank, and game taken from the surrounding plains. For adventurers pushing deep into the harsh wilderness, his stocks provide vital nourishment. Beyond basic trade, he maintains close ties with the Horde capital, regularly shipping carefully selected meats across Durotar to Gryshka, the innkeeper of the Valley of Strength.

Zargh often enlists wandering couriers to carry fresh shipments of meat to Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar via wind rider, ensuring the supplies arrive before spoiling. Their relationship appears to be more than just professional: correspondence from Gryshka recalls a mishap where Zargh lost a finger, and upon receiving word back from her, Zargh hints at a possible wedding invitation in the traveler's future.
Zargh is located at the Crossroads, the central Horde settlement in the Barrens. He operates as a meat vendor amidst the camp's merchants.

Zarlman Two-Moons is a revered tauren mystic residing in Bloodhoof Village in central Mulgore. While Baine Bloodhoof oversees the village's daily earthly affairs, Zarlman guides its spiritual life and communions with the spirits. He plays a vital role in initiating young tauren into adulthood through the sacred Rite of Vision.

Within Bloodhoof Village, leadership is divided between the physical and the mystical. Baine Bloodhoof commands the settlement's defense and temporal needs, but it is Zarlman Two-Moons who maintains the harmony of the spirit world. In a culture deeply rooted in reverence for the Earth Mother and ancestral wisdom, Zarlman serves as a conduit between the everyday struggles of the plains and the timeless voices of the past.

Zarlman's most crucial duty to his people is administering the Rite of Vision, a traditional trial every maturing tauren must undertake. By guiding initiates to prepare sacred draughts and listen closely to ancestral portents, he helps young hunters, shamans, and warriors discover their destined path and spirit guides. Under his instruction, initiates learn that physical strength on the plains means little without spiritual clarity.

Zarlman Two-Moons is a prominent tauren mystic stationed in Bloodhoof Village. While Baine Bloodhoof handles temporal leadership and the town's practical defense, Zarlman watches over the settlement's spiritual well-being and guides young adventurers through ancient tribal traditions.

Zenn Foulhoof is a satyr lingering just east of Dolanaar in Teldrassil. He approaches passersby with requests for forest reagents, while the local night elves keep a close eye on him.

Unlike most satyrs, who are outright hostiles serving demonic masters, Zenn Foulhoof somehow secured a tenuous tolerance just outside Dolanaar. He maintains a friendly facade, claiming he has changed or wants to trade in harmless forest reagents like spider fangs and tiger lily scents. In reality, he manipulates gullible youths to procure ingredients for foul rituals. Dolanaar's council refuses to let him operate unchecked; rather than executing him immediately, they order adventurers to humiliate him by feeding him corrupted forest fruit, temporarily transforming the scheming satyr into a harmless frog.
Why isn't Zenn Foulhoof immediately attacked by the night elves?

Zenn maintains a friendly veneer and has not yet openly committed atrocities on the World Tree, leading the council of Dolanaar to discipline him through public humiliation and watchfulness rather than an immediate death sentence.

Zevrost is an orc warlock trainer secluded within the subterranean Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He mentors developing warlocks of the Horde, guiding them through the hazardous disciplines of fel magic, summoning rituals, and binding dark artifacts.

Tucked away deep in the caverns of the Cleft of Shadow, Zevrost is one of the principal mentors for Horde warlocks residing in Thrall's capital. While the broader orcish society remains wary of fel energies following the demonic corruption of their past, practitioners like Zevrost are tolerated under strict watch. He instills in his pupils the harsh discipline required to command demonic forces without succumbing to their corruptive nature, asserting that the fel only ruins those lacking inner strength.

Beyond basic instruction in spells and curses, Zevrost acts as a conduit for more ambitious dark undertakings. Initiates seeking advanced implements—such as the Orb of Orahil or the means to summon a fiery Felsteed—frequently pass through his hands. He directs aspirational practitioners to other masters of the craft, such as Menara Voidrender in the Barrens, ensuring that those who wield shadow magic push their capabilities to their absolute limits.
Zevrost is an orc warlock trainer stationed in the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. He teaches novice and experienced Horde warlocks new incantations and guides them on pivotal class rituals.

Zjolnir is a Darkspear troll mount breeder stationed in Sen'jin Village along the southern coast of Durotar. He provides trained riding raptors to the Darkspear and trustworthy champions of the Horde. For troll riders, his stable of vicious, loyal beasts is a point of deep cultural pride.

Situated near the pens of Sen'jin Village, Zjolnir tends to the fierce raptors favored as mounts by the Darkspear trolls. Raptors are temperamental and predatory by nature, requiring an expert hand to raise and saddle for war. Zjolnir freely provides these prized whistled mounts to fellow trolls who have learned the necessary riding arts. Outsiders belonging to the wider Horde must first earn the exalted trust of the Darkspear tribe before Zjolnir will consider trusting them with one of his pack.
Zjolnir is located in Sen'jin Village, a coastal Darkspear settlement found in the southern reaches of Durotar, standing beside the village's raptor pens.

Zor Lonetree is a knowledgeable orc advisor found within Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. Well-versed in external affairs and Alliance politics, he aids the Horde by analyzing enemy artifacts and directing travelers to troubled regions across Kalimdor.

Stationed within Grommash Hold alongside the Horde's high leadership, Zor Lonetree serves as a shrewd advisor who keeps a watchful eye on developments beyond Durotar. He possesses an unusually keen understanding of human and Alliance politics, making him an invaluable counselor when foreign curiosities or political threats reach the capital. From inspecting noble jewelry recovered from human settlements to monitoring disturbances among the land's spirits in Stonetalon Mountains, Lonetree ensures the warchief's court stays informed on matters both mundane and mystical.

Zureetha Fargaze is an orc mentor stationed in the Valley of Trials in Durotar alongside Foreman Thazz'ril. Vigilant against corruption, she directs young Horde recruits to investigate and root out the dark influence of the Burning Blade cult hiding within the valley.

While Foreman Thazz'ril oversees the labor and discipline of young orcs and Darkspear trolls, Zureetha Fargaze keeps watch for subtler, more insidious threats. The Burning Blade cult has secretly infiltrated the Valley of Trials, corrupting lesser demons and gathering strength in the nearby cavern of Burning Blade Coven. Zureetha tasks untested adventurers with retrieving medallions from the cultists to confirm their presence and dismantle their early operations before directing seasoned recruits outward into Durotar.
